reason: I'd sign up with the café's link and do the free collab, sure, but my collabs are free food and products, so paying for a pass to get more barter deals doesn't add up for me yet. I already get 2-3 DMs a week without paying anyone.
objection: Local cafés pay in food, not money, so where does the ₹499 come back to me? And the café getting ₹150 when I buy, plus me owing them promo videos, makes it feel like I'm paying to work for them.
would_change_my_mind: If my free collab through Mitra turned into an actual paid collab, or the pass came with at least one guaranteed paid gig that covers the ₹499.
